title: Every Memory Is A Rewrite
hook: Every memory you have is *a rewrite*

scenes.text: Every time you remember something, you change it.

Memories aren't stored like files. When you recall one, it becomes unstable for a while, and your brain saves it again, mixed with whatever you feel now. Scientists call it reconsolidation. In experiments, people have been led to confidently recall events that never happened.
Your most vivid memory isn't the original. It's the latest copy of a copy.
So the next time you're certain, remember...
